neko_client.config.comment.searchBox:
Shows a search box on top of the Void Warehouse screen.
Match by name, pinyin, initials or registry id. Turning this off also stops the catalog request.
neko_client.config.comment.fillCombo:
Hold this, then left-click a warehouse slot to fill that slot up to your
inventory's limit. Must include a mouse button (BUTTON_1 = left).
Empty = off (the toggle above then does nothing).
neko_client.config.comment.openGui: Opens this mod's config screen (toggles and hotkeys live there).
neko_client.gui.title: Void Warehouse Search · Settings
